title: desmoscelis villosa
intro: Desmoscelis villosa, commonly known as False Unicorn Root, is a plant species native to North America. It is known for its potential health benefits, which include relieving respiratory issues and menstrual cramps, as well as its ability to support immune function. The therapeutic actions of Desmoscelis villosa include expectorant, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to soothe coughs and alleviate pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpene lactones and other compounds, such as sterols and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
